stage_instruction: Select a stage to see its role.

stages.label: Momentum
stages.explanation: Compute the exponential moving average of the gradients.
stages.title: Momentum

stages.label: Tangent projection
stages.explanation: Project the momentum onto the tangent space at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline" data-tex="W_t"><mrow><msub><mi>W</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></math>.
stages.definition: This projection is central to our convergence analysis.
stages.title: Tangent projection

stages.label: Orthogonalize
stages.explanation: Form <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline" data-tex="O_t=UV^\top"><mrow><msub><mi>O</mi><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>U</mi><msup><mi>V</mi><mo>⊤</mo></msup></mrow></math> from the singular vectors of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline" data-tex="\Phi_t"><mrow><msub><mi>Φ</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow></math>.
stages.definition: This gives the direction for a spectral steepest-descent step.
stages.title: Orthogonalize

stages.label: Rescale
stages.explanation: Scale the update direction using the radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline" data-tex="R"><mrow><mi>R</mi></mrow></math>.
stages.definition: This controls the proposed step size relative to the weight scale.
stages.title: Rescale
stages.formula:
<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block" data-tex="\widetilde{\nabla}_t=
\frac{R O_t}{\|O_t\|_{\mathcal M}+\epsilon}."><mrow><msub><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>∇</mi></mrow><mo stretchy="true">~</mo></mover><mi>t</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>R</mi><msub><mi>O</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mrow><msub><mrow class="math-norm"><mo form="prefix" fence="true" stretchy="false" symmetric="true" lspace="0" rspace="0">‖</mo><mrow><msub><mi>O</mi><mi>t</mi></msub></mrow><mo form="postfix" fence="true" stretchy="false" symmetric="true" lspace="0" rspace="0">‖</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="script">M</mi></mrow></msub><mo>+</mo><mi>ε</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>.</mo></mrow></math>

stages.label: Retract
stages.explanation: Map the updated weights back to the constraint set.
stages.definition: The next step starts from weights that satisfy the constraint.
stages.title: Retract

panel_a.title: Validation-loss difference from MACRO-fro
panel_a.note: Positive values mean that the oblique method has higher validation loss.
panel_a.help: Select a point to see the loss values.

panel_b.title: Maximum row norm during training
panel_b.help: Select a curve to highlight it.

figure02_caption: (a) Validation-loss differences from MACRO-fro. (b) Maximum row norms for MACRO-fro and MACRO-iobl during training.
post_figure_observation: Neither oblique variant reduces validation loss in this comparison. MACRO-fro and MACRO-iobl also show similar maximum row norms during training.
